key_points: UBS raised Newmont's price target and reaffirmed it as preferred large-cap gold miner, citing clarity on capital returns and a path to growing production per share
Key overhang—potential large payment to Barrick—is easing, reducing a major source of uncertainty for the investment case
Seeking Alpha published a bullish thesis arguing improved prospects outweigh rising risks
SimplyWall.st flagged NEM as potentially undervalued based on UBS backing and easing Fourmile payment concerns
Some IBD 50 gold miner components showing technical sell signals—a minor counterweight but not specific to NEM
